Discover Innovative Solutions for Your Business with RMIT. Whether you're seeking to employ dynamic student talent, collaborate on cutting-edge research, or find tailored workforce training solutions, our skilled staff and driven students are here to help. Partner with us to achieve your goals, and let's create value together. Reach out today.

The Industry Engagement Team can assist you with:

  • Student engagement & internships
  • RMIT training
  • Research partnerships
  • Sponsorship, scholarships & prizes
  • Technology & innovation
  • Facilities & services

RMIT University respectfully acknowledges their Ancestors and Elders, past and present.
